name: travel-policy-copilot
description: Evaluated, version-aware RAG pipeline with hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, grounded answers, citations, abstention, Streamlit, and a live Vercel demo.

paragraphs: A local, production-shaped Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application for answering questions over versioned travel-policy documents. It demonstrates the full lifecycle: ingestion, chunking, persistent embeddings, hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, grounded generation, citations, abstention, evaluation, telemetry, tests, a Streamlit interface, and container deployment.
All included policies are fictional examples. They are not Mondee or supplier policies.
